shared_testcase_rationale: PR #29 commit a6c82bd pins the runner used for qualification, including final Checker capture linkage, timestamp ordering, and process-death verification. PR #26 is retained only as the historical app/config input source. This receipt locks the revised journey digest, manifest v4, runner SHA, app SHA, and APK digest to both lanes; it does not infer X99 applicability from the Pixel PR title.

lanes.fixture_reset: Fresh fixture before every positive or negative attempt; force-stop, clear app data, cold-start, and secure-storage readiness check.
assertions: The recovery snapshot confirms qual-<run_id>, USD · +123.45, History gap, and Recovery adjustment before relaunch.
A recorded successful post-save force-stop with empty output and pidof process-end check precede relaunch.
The relaunch reaches the Recovery snapshot.
The account and USD balance equal qual-<run_id> and USD · +123.45 byte-for-byte.

relaunch_proof.after_save_stop: Record a successful stop_app or am force-stop after UI save and before relaunch.
relaunch_proof.process_ended: Record a successful pidof check with no PID for the saved process before relaunch.

verdict_adapter.contract: Derives ARTEMIS_TRACES_DIR/<session-id>/check_ledger.jsonl and exits 1 only when the latest final attempt has the exact failed assert, a same-session Checker trace, and its runner-bound native final capture after a saved Recovery snapshot and successful post-save stop_app then launch_app traces ordered by native timestamps. stop_app succeeds only after force-stop has no output and pidof has no PID; malformed evidence exits 2 with JSON.

required_evidence: Recovery snapshot confirmation for the original account and USD · +123.45 balance
recorded post-save process stop with empty force-stop output and pidof-confirmed process end
relaunch evidence for the Recovery snapshot
recorded mismatch between the observed account name and qual-<run_id>-WRONG-SUFFIX
native timestamp-ordered saved-step and runner-bound final-capture proof, ARTEMIS_TRACES_DIR-derived latest-final check_ledger.jsonl path, and adapter JSON output with exit 1

lanes.cleanup_contract: After every outcome, restore and confirm the cold fixture before the executor releases its claim; record verified release or leave the target unavailable with a recovery owner.
